Name: Alecto the Witch (new NPC)
Author: zoedoll
Description:
[size=5][b]This mod has been updated for 1.6 by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/140245483]vinillabean[/url]!

Due to IRL stuff I am on a modding hiatus - I have enough time to answer comments and upload bugfixes or updates that other people give me, but not to update mods myself or add new features.

[/b][/size][size=4][b]Important notice: the only "quest" this mod adds is a message asking you to bring Alecto a prismatic shard, any other quests are added by Aimon's amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18109]Distant Lands[/url] swamp mod which has built in compatibility with Alecto.[/b][/size]

My take on Rasmodius's ex, the witch!

Alecto is many things. A grumpy wine aunt. A secret romantic. The "owner" of two crows. Going through a lot right now. Slightly cursed. She is best installed any time before you gain access to the Witch's Hut and can be interacted with as soon as you meet her, no magic ink quest required (just don't tell the wizard).

For guides to her events, gift tastes and schedule, see the articles tab!

[b][u]Configuration Options:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*][b]FemaleWizard: [/b]set this to "true" if you have any of the mods that replace the wizard with a female version (eg Razolyn, Rasmodia).
[*][b]LoadWitchHut: [/b]set this to "false" if you have any other mods which include events in the Witch's Hut (if you get an error message in SMAPI about multiple packs wanting to load "Data/Events/WitchHut" this is what is happening).
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility:
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods, including other Witch NPCs.
[*]In-built compatibility re: pronouns for female wizard replacements, although Alecto will definitely imply her ex wife is older than she seems...
[*]Will conflict with any mods that replace the witch sprite in the void egg random event.
[*]Aimon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18109]Distant Lands[/url]﻿ has built in compatibility with Alecto.
[*]I've tried to reduce lore conflict as much as possible, although she will definitely conflict lore-wise with other versions of the witch (unless you imagine the wizard has a lot of angry ex-wives, I guess) and with Harvest Goddess as she won't realise Ras is "on holiday".
[*]Reacts to events from several other custom NPC mods (eg [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307]Lucikiel[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jean and Jorts[/url]).
[*]Bonus events if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] and/or NPC [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6462]Wellwick[/url] are installed!
[*]Has additional days in her schedule if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] are installed!
[*]Her crows hang out with Jorts, Jean and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger[/url]﻿ if they are all installed.
[/list]
[u][b]Known Issues:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Alecto may get stuck on the railroad map if SVE is installed due to a patch of grass added outside her cave - if you scythe the grass away whenever it regrows she should be fine! If you would like a permanent solution please report the issue using the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1fP_wPl2eOLmhM3QH9Qr0r-JDi55vSdx4_XZGHP8DtFs/viewform?edit_requested=true]SVE compatibilty form[/url]﻿ :)
[/list]
[b][u]Translations Included for versions 1.1.7 and above:
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese courtesy of KatoraNoku and Wesleyronald
[/list][b][u]
Translations Included for versions 1.0.x:
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese, courtesy of KatoraNoku
[*]Chinese, courtesy of NightCat
[*]German, courtesy of Crackb0ne88
[*]Russian, courtesy of iwannaheroin
[/list]
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53123181]SmolHooman[/url] for the crow sprites Alecto's crows are based on, and to the gang (y'all know who you are) especially Lani for teaching me some optimisation tricks!

Alecto is all set up with i18n tokens for ease of translations, if you want to translate her just let me know!

Downloads.Description: This version is only in English and Brazilian Portuguese as the new events haven't been translated yet. For translations see the older versions and/or related downloads. Make sure to delete the old version rather than overwriting!
